name: marketing-sections
title: Sections
description: Section components created with Tailwind CSS. These responsive, SEO-optimized layouts are perfect for building content blocks, feature sections, and landing page segments for marketing websites and web applications.
useWhen: Explaining a feature, product benefit, or story with paired copy and an illustrative image.
Breaking a landing page into scannable, visually distinct content sections.
avoidWhen: The image is purely decorative and creates an unnecessary large gap.
The content is a dense comparison or task workflow that needs a more structured layout.
responsiveBehavior: Split layouts stack image and content vertically on small screens. Preserve a comfortable text measure and avoid placing essential copy over an image at narrow widths.
accessibility: Use a meaningful heading that fits the page outline.
Decorative images use empty alt text; informative images need concise descriptive alt text.
Keep source order logical when CSS visually rearranges columns.
